The [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Beastmaster/Legends|beastmaster]] [[Adrazar]] attempted to train packs of [[Scyk/Legends|scyks]]&mdash;[[Reptile/Legends|reptiles]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]&mdash;sometime before the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. However, the creatures turned on each other and [[Death/Legends|killed]] each other in a frenzy. The '''only scyk''' that survived was then trained by Adrazar to guard his [[Adrazar's domicile|domicile]] on the planet [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]].<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Adrazar's scyk was first mentioned in the Codex entry for scyks in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="Codex" />
